title: PhaseGateRecord
description: Records the outcome of a phase gate review. Human approval required for 'go' decisions.

id.description: Phase gate record ID, e.g. PG-0001

phase.description: Name or ID of the phase being gated

decision.description: Phase gate outcome. Only 'go' requires a valid ISO 8601 timestamp.

approver.description: Identity of the human approver. Must not be 'AI', 'Codex', or 'AIDEN'.

linked_pr.description: Codex task PR reference, e.g. PR-0001-root-scaffold

conditions.description: Any conditions attached to the go/hold decision

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime of approval. Required when decision is 'go' or 'no-go'. 'pending' is NOT a valid value.

audit_event_ref.description: Reference to the audit-event trace_id for this gate decision

not.description: AI agents cannot approve Human gate decisions.
